verdict.rationale: Graphite offers cross-repo PR tracking with custom filters (docs-11) and a codebase-aware AI reviewer that pulls related files/dependencies/context from other PRs (docs-15, docs-16), which helps a lead follow changes broadly, but there is no evidence of explicit monorepo-scale review tooling, cross-repo stack visualization, or dependency mapping across repositories in a single coherent review flow. Missing for 10: monorepo-specific review features, cross-repo diff/stack visualization, and independent evidence that reviewers actually use it to understand large or multi-repo spans coherently.
